mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.type AS type, t.user_id AS user_id, t.realname_masked AS realname_masked, t.id_card_masked AS id_card_masked, t.status AS status, t.reviewed_by AS reviewed_by, t.reviewed_at AS reviewed_at, t.reject_reason AS reject_reason, t.submitted_at AS submitted_at FROM ( SELECT 'REALNAME' AS type, r.id AS id, r.user_id AS user_id, r.real_name AS realname_masked, r.id_card_masked AS id_card_masked, UPPER(r.status) AS status, r.audited_by AS reviewed_by, r.audited_at AS reviewed_at, r.reject_reason AS reject_reason, r.created_at AS submitted_at FROM realname_auth r WHERE (#{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'realname') AND (#{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR r.status = #{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR r.created_at >= #{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND (#{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR r.created_at <= #{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) UNION ALL SELECT 'ENTERPRISE' AS type, e.id AS id, e.user_id AS user_id, e.company_name AS realname_masked, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(e.credit_code) <= 8 THEN REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(e.credit_code)) ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(e.credit_code, 4), '****', RIGHT(e.credit_code, 4)) END AS id_card_masked, UPPER(e.status) AS status, e.audited_by AS reviewed_by, e.audited_at AS reviewed_at, e.reject_reason AS reject_reason, e.created_at AS submitted_at FROM enterprise_auth e WHERE (#{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'enterprise') AND (#{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR e.status = #{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR e.created_at >= #{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND (#{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR e.created_at <= #{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ) t ORDER BY t.submitted_at DESC, t.type ASC, t.id DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM realname_auth r WHERE (#{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'realname') AND (#{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR r.status = #{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR r.created_at >= #{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND (#{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR r.created_at <= #{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise_auth e WHERE (#{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{bo.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'enterprise') AND (#{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR e.status = #{bo.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR e.created_at >= #{bo.beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND (#{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL OR e.created_at <= #{bo.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}))
